stable.notes:
License activation and trial reliability hotfix.

- License keys now work when pasted with typographic dashes, invisible formatting, or without the HIB prefix.
- Eligible 7-day trials now work more reliably on shared networks.
- If both licensed devices are occupied, you can verify your purchase email, remove an old device, and activate this Mac without waiting for support.
- Activation errors are clearer and guide you to the right recovery step.
